steps.content: No matter how many enemies she's destroyed, more and more raging monsters rush toward her, coming from collapsed walls, from shady alleys, and from every corner in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Indistinct Figures
steps.content: Power! Power!! The strong prey on the weak! If you win, you'll be the king!!

steps.speaker: Indistinct Figures
steps.content: F*** justice. Syndicate is a free place! Violence doesn't discriminate!!
They are charging at the child who is staggering on alone. She can't advance anymore, her broken body unable to support her own weight any longer. She kneels down on the ground.
Your shackles emit a blinding light, shattering the violent phantoms and the broken streets. The two of you have returned to the desolate wilderness with the rusty towers.

steps.speaker: Child Zoya
steps.content: <size=30>Still not... over...?</size>

steps.speaker: Child Zoya
steps.content: <size=30>How much longer... do I have to go on...</size>

steps.speaker: Choice
options: No one is going to hurt you anymore

steps.content: Hurt her? No, all of this has made her stronger.
You hear a strange voice. A man in black is standing before you, holding up an umbrella.
Shh—I'm here to pick her up.
Something is wrong with Zoya. Her wounds are beginning to heal, her body is emitting purple smoke, and her voice is no longer shaking.

steps.speaker: Child Zoya
steps.content: ...It's not going to end. Everything is completely rotten, but no one is going to end it...
The suddenly emerged shackles pierce through you and hold you in place. Is this a backlash?

steps.speaker: Man Holding Up Umbrella
steps.content: No... It's a well-intended warning. It's warning you not to get close or be a hindrance. Your shackles are protecting you.

steps.speaker: Man Holding Up Umbrella
steps.content: Of course. That's the law of this world. This is her spiritual world.
Little Zoya stands up. Her eyes are no longer aimless, but are instead radiating frenzied determination.

steps.speaker: Child Zoya
steps.content: In that case... I will...

steps.speaker: Zoya?
steps.content: I'm putting an end to it all!!!

Her broken body bursts like a cocoon, and a pair of raw and bloody wings tears open her back, dragging a huge monster's body out of the cocoon—an enormous Corruptor, born at the same time as the Black Ring.
She flaps her wings and flies up high in the sky, vanishing in the luminous red ring at the apex of the sky. You're bound by the shackles and left on the slowly collapsing surface of the earth.

steps.speaker: Man Holding Up Umbrella
steps.content: Perfect power, perfect obsession. She's the perfect fruit nurtured by Syndicate. She deserves to be chosen.

steps.speaker: Man Holding Up Umbrella
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>birth of the Corpseborne</color> is successful. The <color=#fb9259>Ring</color> has descended. Both she and the <color=#fb9259>Host</color> are free now.
